_meta.description: The log2timeline stream (logs-dxdfir.log2timeline-*): the logs-*-* base + logs-dxdfir@settings + the Plaso super-timeline fields, plus the shared @winlog model its winevtx submodule normalises EVTX records onto. Priority 500 — higher than the logs-dxdfir.*-* fallback (200) — so this stream composes only this lane's model(s), not every lane's, and bare field names stay contained to the stream that uses them.
